title: 第3章 术技与符箓第4章 超魔体质
slug: 精灵族的修仙者第342章巢穴
content_zh:
看着枝头沉甸甸的蜜铃，安东脸上露出满意的笑容。
不同属性的灵气，决定了修仙者未来的发展方向和战斗风格。
而修炼了太初归藏诀的他，却可以随意分化出五种属性的灵气，意味着他可以修炼几乎所有功法、术技和符箓。
潜力之高不言而喻。
安东闭目凝神，定位到那枚灵魂深处的大道玉简，开始浏览起来。
炼出灵气后，修仙者便可以开始修习术技和符箓。
其中术技主要分为术法和武技两大类。
掌心雷、缚身咒、铁衣咒、回春术……这些都属于术法范畴。
不过对于刚刚凝练出一口灵气的安东来说，术法的修炼难度还是有点超标了。
修士一般都是等到炼气中期才会开始接触术法。
炼气初期的修士，往往更多从武技入手。
当然，这里的武技可不是凡俗拳脚，而是货真价实的通神仙武，施展时自有异象相随。
熔兵手、穿云龙吟、禁绝金甲、神阳剑诀、碧波指、如影随形......
琳琅满目的武技看得安东都有些眼花缭乱了。
“学不完，根本学不完......”
安东咧了咧嘴，这才发现自己有选择困难症。
他没立刻做决定，只是简单浏览一遍，心里有了底，紧跟着便浏览起符箓相关的知识。
符箓也是炼气期修士的重要战斗和辅助手段之一。
甚至到了筑基期，许多修士依旧离不开符箓。
起初安东还以为制符必须要朱砂黄纸之类的工具，可仔细浏览过后，才发现并非如此。

符无正形，以气而灵。
修至深处，信手一画即为符箓。
不过这得是觉醒了神识的筑基期修士才能做到的事情。
炼气期修士还是得乖乖画符。
尤其是刚接触符箓的炼气期修士，最好借助灵引作为媒介，不然绘符成功率会低得令人发指。
不过灵引并不要求一定要黄纸朱砂，只要是具有灵性的材料都可以。
包括但不限于桃木、玉竹、灵植汁液、灵兽妖兽的皮毛、血液、骨头甚至是鳞片等等。
“学习绘符之前，还得先解决材料问题才行。”
安东暗暗思忖。
相比符箓对战斗力的提升，他现在更看重符箓的日常辅助作用。
比如纳物符，可以存取一定体积的物品，相当于一次性的空间戒指。
聚灵符，贴在建筑内部，可以聚集灵气，提高建筑内的灵气浓度，加快吐纳灵气的效率，相当于极致弱化版的聚灵阵。
还有清净符、遁形符、安神符、寻人符等等不一而足。
“等解决了材料问题，先把聚灵符弄出来，以后就不用跑那么远去修炼了。”
现阶段，安东最重要的目标还是想办法提高炼化灵气的效率，争取尽快筑基。
......
第二天一早。
安东在优美的歌声中醒来，睁开眼睛从藤床上坐起。
透过窗户向外望去，一个纤细的精灵女孩正坐在树枝上低声吟唱，淡金色长发垂落如瀑，晨光穿透叶隙，在她周身镀上一层朦胧的光晕，仿佛一幅会呼吸的油画。
content_en:
Looking at the heavy honey bells on the branches, Anton had a satisfied smile on his face.
Different attributes of aura determine the future development direction and fighting style of the immortal cultivator.
But after practicing the Taichu Guizang Jue, he can differentiate the spiritual energy of five attributes at will, which means that he can practice almost all exercises, techniques and talismans.
The potential is self-evident.
Anton closed his eyes and concentrated, located the Dao Jade Slip deep in his soul, and began to browse.
After refining the spiritual energy, the cultivator can begin to practice techniques and talismans.
Techniques are mainly divided into two categories: techniques and martial arts.
Palm Thunder, Body Binding Curse, Iron Clothes Curse, Rejuvenation Technique... these all belong to the category of magic.
However, for Anton, who had just condensed a breath of spiritual energy, the difficulty of practicing the technique was still a bit too high.
Monks usually wait until the middle stage of Qi refining before they start to learn spells.
Monks in the early stage of Qi refining often start with martial arts.
Of course, the martial arts here are not ordinary fists and kicks, but genuine divine martial arts, which have their own visions accompanying them when used.
Melting Hand, Cloud-Piercing Dragon's Song, Forbidden Golden Armor, Shenyang Sword Technique, Blue Wave Finger, Follow Like a Shadow...
Anton was dazzled by the dazzling array of martial arts.
"I can't finish learning, I can't finish learning at all..."
Anton grinned and realized that he had difficulty choosing.
He didn't make a decision immediately, he just browsed it briefly, and then started to browse the knowledge related to the talisman.
Talismans are also one of the important combat and auxiliary means for monks in the Qi refining stage.
Even in the foundation building stage, many monks still cannot do without talismans.
At first Anton thought that tools such as cinnabar and yellow paper were necessary to make talismans, but after looking through them carefully, he discovered that this was not the case.
The talisman has no formal shape, and is inspired by Qi.
After practicing to the depths, you can draw a talisman with your hands.
But this can only be done by monks in the foundation building stage who have awakened their spiritual consciousness.
During the Qi refining period, monks still have to draw talismans obediently.
Especially for monks in the Qi refining stage who are new to talismans, it is best to use spiritual guidance as a medium, otherwise the success rate of drawing talismans will be extremely low.
However, the spirit guide does not require yellow paper and cinnabar, as long as it is a spiritual material.
Including but not limited to peach wood, Polygonatum odoratum, spiritual plant juice, the fur, blood, bones and even scales of spiritual beasts and monsters, etc.
"Before you learn to draw symbols, you must first solve the problem of materials."
Anton thought secretly.
Compared with the improvement of combat effectiveness of the talisman, he now values ​​the daily auxiliary role of the talisman more.
For example, the object storage talisman can store and withdraw items of a certain volume, which is equivalent to a one-time space ring.
The Spirit Gathering Talisman, attached to the interior of a building, can gather spiritual energy, increase the concentration of spiritual energy in the building, and speed up the efficiency of breathing in spiritual energy. It is equivalent to an extremely weakened version of the Spirit Gathering Array.
There are also purifying talismans, escape talismans, soothing talismans, searching talismans, and so on.
"When the material problem is solved, let's get the spirit-gathering talisman first. Then we won't have to travel so far to practice in the future."
At this stage, Anton's most important goal is to find ways to improve the efficiency of refining spiritual energy and strive to build a foundation as soon as possible.
...
Early the next morning.
Anton woke up to the beautiful singing, opened his eyes and sat up on the wicker bed.
Looking out through the window, a slender elf girl was sitting on a branch singing softly, with long pale golden hair hanging down like a waterfall. The morning light penetrated through the gaps in the leaves, casting a hazy halo around her, like a breathing oil painting.
